answers.core: This is a pretty standard implementation of long distance volumetrics and would enable several other add-ons which would help the overall godot ecosystem. It could be made into an add-on if the ability to read the values from a fog volume at an exact position was added however the complexity of doing it in a script would make it very difficult compared to exposing it natively.
answers.workaround: No, since it is not currently possible to read the contents of fog volumes from user facing shaders or scripts.

title: Implement ray marched volumetric fog as an extension of the current froxel-based solution
